about: American Football > Game Pants (until now coming soon; RUGBYV 2026-11-23, coordinator; booklet cards 55833 front / 56345 back, D:/3d-app/tripo/cards): Tripo model afootball-pants-textured.glb (shape only; its pads and knee panels are its own shape), coloured from afootball-pants-parts.glb by viewer/tripo-glbparts.mjs: its waistband with the belt the Waistband part, its leg cuffs the Cuffs part (both the Main colour unless given their own). Shown by the flag afPants on a Shorts tile (the viewer part trackpants, as the track pants and leggings). Look: the cards' golden yellow all over (body, belt, cuffs) with the jersey's navy as Secondary; our 3 mark and wordmark low on the legs in the cards' navy (brandInk/crestInk; the wordmark on the wearer's right leg where the cards have their script, the 3 mark on the left where they have the number); the cards' number on the legs and their own text are not copied.
